verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents explicit rule/trigger-based automation: custom Auto Labels driven by user-defined AI prompts, Auto Archive, Auto Drafts, and a stated capability to "create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect" with admin governance over agent building. This directly matches the ai-native automation-depth story of defining rules that fire actions on events.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the rule engine's reliability and richer documentation of trigger/condition/action logic beyond marketing copy.
